name: middleware-next
title: Next.js Route Handler Wrapper
description: Route-handler wrapper (withAmplio) that owns the request wide event - this is not Next.js middleware.ts.
docs: Wrap route handlers: `export const GET = withAmplio(handler)`. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/app/api/trpc/[trpc]/route.ts for you.
